title: Error E4012: TLS handshake failure
text: E4012 means the gateway could not complete the TLS handshake with the broker. It usually follows an expired device certificate or a clock that is far from the correct time. Check the system time first, then renew the certificate.

title: Error E4013: broker refused connection
text: E4013 is returned when the MQTT broker rejects the client after a successful TLS session. The most common cause is a client ID already in use by another device, or credentials that were revoked by an administrator.

title: Cellular fallback
text: When the Ethernet uplink stays down for longer than 90 seconds, the gateway switches to its LTE modem. It returns to Ethernet after the wired link has been stable for five minutes. Data charges apply while the modem is active.

title: Static IP configuration
text: Use nimctl net set --static to assign a fixed address, netmask and default route. The setting survives reboots. Run nimctl net reset to go back to DHCP.

title: Firewall ports
text: The gateway needs outbound access to port 8883 for MQTT over TLS and port 443 for firmware downloads. No inbound ports are required, because all sessions start from the device.

title: Offline message buffering
text: If the broker can't be reached, telemetry is stored in a ring buffer on flash with room for about 72 hours of data. Messages are replayed in order after reconnecting. The oldest readings are overwritten when the buffer fills up.

title: Battery backup
text: The internal lithium pack keeps the gateway running for about four hours after mains power is lost. The unit sends a power-loss alert immediately and shuts down cleanly at 10 percent charge.

title: Power supply requirements
text: The gateway accepts 12 to 24 volts DC and draws at most 15 watts. Use a supply rated for the full temperature range of the installation site.

title: Low-power sleep schedule
text: Solar installations can use nimctl power schedule to put the device to sleep overnight. The radio and sensors are switched off, and the real-time clock wakes the unit at the configured hour.

title: Over-the-air firmware updates
text: Firmware images are downloaded in the background and verified against a signature before installation. The device writes the image to the inactive slot and reboots into it during the maintenance window.

title: Automatic firmware rollback
text: If a new firmware image fails to report healthy within ten minutes of booting, the bootloader returns to the previous slot. The failed version is recorded so that it won't be installed again automatically.

title: Error E7001: signature verification failed
text: E7001 appears when a firmware image does not match its signature. The image is discarded and the current version keeps running. Repeated occurrences suggest a corrupted download or the wrong signing key.

title: Factory reset
text: Hold the recessed button for ten seconds until the status LED flashes red, or run nimctl factory-reset. This erases configuration, certificates and buffered telemetry, but the firmware version stays the same.

title: Device certificate renewal
text: Device certificates are valid for two years. Run nimctl cert renew to request a new one from the provisioning service. Renewal happens automatically 30 days before expiry when the device is online.

title: Rotating API tokens
text: Tokens for the management API can be replaced with nimctl token rotate. The previous token keeps working for one hour, which gives integrations time to pick up the new value.

title: Secure boot
text: The first-stage bootloader in ROM verifies each boot stage before running it. Devices that fail verification stop in recovery mode and flash the status LED amber.

title: Adding a Modbus sensor
text: Declare the slave address, baud rate and register map in sensors.yaml, then run nimctl sensors reload. New readings appear within one polling interval.

title: Error E2103: Modbus timeout
text: E2103 means a Modbus slave did not reply in time. Check the wiring and termination resistor on the RS-485 bus, confirm the baud rate, and make sure that no two sensors share an address.

title: Sensor polling interval
text: The poll_interval_ms option controls how often each sensor is read. The default is 5000 milliseconds. Short intervals on long RS-485 buses can cause timeouts.

title: Calibration offsets
text: Each channel in sensors.yaml accepts a scale and an offset that are applied before publishing. Use them to correct a sensor that reads consistently high or low against a reference instrument.

title: Overheating protection
text: Above 80 degrees Celsius the CPU clock is reduced. Above 95 degrees the gateway stops the radio and shuts down until it has cooled. Mount the unit away from direct sun and allow airflow around the heat sink.

title: Viewing device logs
text: Run nimctl logs --follow to stream logs over SSH. Older logs are rotated daily and kept for seven days. Use nimctl logs --export to create an archive for support.

title: Status LED patterns
text: Solid green means connected to the broker. Blinking green means connecting. Amber means recovery mode. Fast red flashes confirm a factory reset in progress.

title: Remote shell access
text: SSH is disabled by default. Enable it for a limited time with nimctl ssh enable --minutes 30. It turns itself off when the timer ends, even if a session is still open.
